assertion: Blur extends beyond child geometry. The ancestor overflow clip truncates the filtered pixels at its padding box, while the visible control preserves them.

browser.reason: Reviewed blur extents and the ancestor clipping edge in all three browsers. A mutation check removes overflow clipping and must still fail this allowance.
